Usage: gotools doctor [options]

  Diagnose your environment: Go installation, module proxy, .gotools.json
  configuration, managed tools, lock file, module integrity, and disk usage.

  Read-only: never modifies tools, the manifest, or the lock. Always exits 0
  (diagnostics are not failures) — invalid flags still exit 2. For CI, gate on
  'doctor --format=json' and the "healthy"/"issues" fields.

  Examples:
    gotools doctor
    gotools doctor --json
    gotools doctor --offline

  Options:
    --format <string>  Output format: json or text (the default)
    --json             Alias for --format=json
    --text             Alias for --format=text
    --offline          Skip the proxy reachability check; probes fail fast instead of touching the network
